display.purpose: Page titles and hero headings only.

label.purpose: Data readouts: model names, timestamps, ranks, badges — set in Geist Mono.

shadows.name: raised-glow
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus lift for buttons, cards, avatars — the primary tactile-depth signal.

shadows.name: floating-shadow
shadows.purpose: Popovers, reaction picker, modals sitting above other UI.

shadows.name: hairline-inset
shadows.purpose: Resting structural border used instead of a visible stroke on most surfaces.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default transition easing for hover/lift/background state changes.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #ffffff; color: #000000; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e0e0e0; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -8px rgba(255,255,255,0.2); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Small secondary control-row button (toggle panels, icon actions).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: none; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); border-radius: 6px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); font-size: 11px; padding: 3px 8px; transition: color 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: Text input / textarea used across search and chat.
components.css: .ds-input { background: #0e0e0e; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: inherit; font-size: 14px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.07); transition: box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1.5px rgba(255,255,255,0.5); }

components.name: History List Item
components.description: Console-style list row: title + mono timestamp, active state marked by background wash only, no color or icon badge.
components.css: .ds-history-item { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; width: 100%; text-align: left; background: none; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 10px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.92); cursor: pointer; } .ds-history-item:hover, .ds-history-item.active { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.07); } .ds-history-title { font-size: 13px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-history-date { font-family: 'Geist Mono', 'SFMono-Regular', monospace; font-size: 11px; color: rgba(255,255,255,0.55); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Generic content card (album, track, tool) — flat at rest, glows and lifts on hover.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #0e0e0e; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.07); border-radius: 12px; padding: 16px; transition: background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s, transform 0.15s; } .ds-card:hover { background: #111111; box-shadow: 0 8px 20px -8px rgba(255,255,255,0.2); transform: translateY(-2px); }

narrative.overview: Cozyroom reads as a DJ booth after hours: a near-black operator surface built to be lived in for hours at a time, not glanced at. It borrows the structure of a familiar dark music app (sidebar library, persistent player, dense list views) but rejects that app's color language entirely — there is no brand hue, no gradient wash, no colorful badge system. The only 'color' is paper-white against void-black, used sparingly as the single interactive signal in a field of near-black surfaces and three tiers of white-on-black text. This restraint is deliberate, not a placeholder: the owner runs Cozyroom as both a daily media console and a live testbed for scaling real infrastructure, so the interface should feel closer to an instrument panel than a consumer entertainment app — legible at a glance, low-decoration, confident about what's interactive.
keyCharacteristics: Monochrome-first: void-black background, white the only accent, three text-opacity tiers for hierarchy.
Operator-console density: compact rows, tables, and dashboards over marketing-style whitespace.
Tactile, not flat: interactive elements lift and glow on hover/press rather than sitting inert.
Spotify-shaped chrome, Cozyroom-owned palette: the current icon is a placeholder, not a binding brand asset.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Paper White is the only accent color in the system. Anything that wants to look selected, primary, or on reaches for it — never a second brand hue.

rules.name: The No-Accent-Token Rule
rules.body: There is no --accent CSS variable — it silently resolves to nothing. The real accent token is var(--green), which is literally white, always paired with color: #000. --purple is currently also white and should be treated as an unused legacy alias.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Machine Rule
rules.body: Switch to Geist Mono only for content that is literally data or system output — never for prose or UI copy.

rules.name: The Light-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Depth is expressed with white ambient glow and subtle lift, never with a second color or a dark drop-shadow, which is invisible on a #050505 background.

rules.name: The Lightness-Is-Data Rule
rules.body: Chart multi-series data encodes importance by lightness, not hue: the most important series is highest-contrast against the panel, fading down the 7-step gray ladder --chart-1..--chart-7 (single series = var(--text)). Replaces every ad-hoc categorical hue palette.

rules.name: The Language-Identity Color Rule
rules.body: TrendingChartMode's LANG_COLORS (GitHub canonical language colors, ~18 of them) are a documented exception to Lightness-Is-Data, scoped to the language dimension and registered as sanctioned ignoreValues — never promoted to a system token.

rules.name: The Data Needs Color Rule (narrowed)
rules.body: Narrowed 2026-09-06 to semantic status ONLY (red=fail, amber=warn, yellow=caution, green=ok), held in chart-scoped tokens --chart-fail/-warn/-caution/-ok. Categorical series moved to the monochrome ladder.

dos: Do treat Paper White as the only accent in any new surface.
Do use the three explicit wide-monitor breakpoints (1920/2560/3840px) for any new reading-width column.
Do give interactive elements a hover glow + slight lift.
Do reserve Geist Mono for data/system readouts only.
donts: Don't reference var(--accent) — it does not exist; use var(--green).
Don't add dark drop shadows — they're invisible on #050505; use the white ambient-glow pattern instead.
Don't treat the current Spotify-shaped play-button icon as a locked brand asset.
Don't touch backend/DB/k8s config as part of design work in this project — scope is frontend/src only.
